## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Source / attribution

For effect ports: upstream file, commit, license and any shared helpers.

## Validation

Commands and results; normal-speed preview or screenshots for visual changes. State what was not tested.

- [ ] No unrelated files, private data or generated caches included
- [ ] Source/license notices preserved
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation updated
- [ ] Migration status accurately reflects implemented and reviewed behavior

- [ ] Effect catalog, source/release counts, both changelogs and evidence links are consistent
